scope: Assistant visual review of all GIF forward-frame diagnostic sheets plus working/rare keyframes; actual playback next; human acceptance pending

observations.idle: Quiet standing, one blink, very small body/tail movement, feet grounded, same starting/ending pose
observations.thinking: Both paws lift beneath chin and small head tilt; readable thought gesture, not strictly one paw
observations.working: Supported desk and gray laptop remain throughout; small alternating paw taps at keyboard; two blinks; no clear detached paw or vanishing prop
observations.waiting: Small head tilt, blink and tail movement; quiet grounded pose
observations.done: Both paws raised beside chest, closed happy eyes and small open mouth; returns to reference pose
observations.error: Brief squeezed eyes, puzzled mouth and both paws near face/chest; returns to original pose
observations.idle-rare: One paw holds nose; other extends outward and moves near chest; motion count differs from two equal fanning strokes. Same master and stable short feet.

decision: Suitable to present as review candidate; human aesthetic judgment pending
